_comment: Copy this to frames.json and fill it in, one entry per frame. Names are yours to pick; they are what --target matches. 'remote_photos_path' must be EPAPER_DATA from that frame's /etc/epaper/epaper.env plus /photos. Prefer key_filename over a password; if you must use one, replace key_filename with "password": "...". frames.json is gitignored.
